info.title: Bily API
info.description: The stable customer API for Bily identity, stores, analytics, commerce, capabilities, and explicitly authorized actions.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Discover the identity and organizations attached to a key.

tags.name: Store data
tags.description: Read store profiles, readiness, catalogs, and connected accounts.

tags.name: Commerce
tags.description: Run scoped commerce reads and explicitly approved GraphQL mutations.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Read normalized advertising, attribution, product, customer, and cohort metrics.

tags.name: Analytics SQL
tags.description: Run constrained read-only SQL over store-scoped Bily datasets.

tags.name: Customer journeys
tags.description: Read customer touchpoints within an authenticated store scope.

tags.name: Capabilities
tags.description: Inspect available connections, support, and advertising assets.

tags.name: Capability actions
tags.description: Synchronize connections and update supported advertising assets.

tags.name: Campaign actions
tags.description: Create or clone supported advertising campaign resources.

tags.name: Tracking connections
tags.description: List and manage store-scoped tracking connections without returning credential secrets.
